proposals.evidence: Full sakāla gives sakālam early in the morning, regional reduced forms and Oriya saaḷa/saaḷiā early. Western sakaye/sakai/sakay and sakaḍ fit this morning family provisionally, preserving source y/ḍ realizations of the expected liquid and qualifying the local sound history and cross-IA transmission. Do not link to unrelated sakala whole or śakala fragment. Exact response: sakai.
